title: Feature Root: Shopping list user-editable notes
description: Shared execution root for delivering editable shopping-list notes across the core document model, markdown parser/renderer, SwiftUI detail flow, and project-level verification. This bead is orchestration-only; all runnable work is expressed in child beads.
acceptance_criteria: All implementation beads needed for the notes field, markdown round-trip, and editing UI are present with explicit dependencies.
Exactly one shared tester bead, one shared documentation bead, and one shared review bead exist as direct children of this feature root.
Developer beads are split into focused changes with clear file scope and ordering.
